claims.text: The Jasper model achieved a state-of-the-art WER of 2.95% on LibriSpeech test-clean using a beam-search decoder with an external language model.
The model also achieved a WER of 3.86% on LibriSpeech test-clean using a greedy decoder without a language model.
Competitive results were reported on the Wall Street Journal and Hub5'00 datasets, although specific WER values for these datasets were not provided.
